metadata.description: JPMorgan ETF. A single-file client-side tool reading ./api/jpmorgan (JPMorgan ETF explorer, product-data and historical-data JSON, SEC EDGAR and Yahoo Finance fallbacks) into a searchable ETF/asset-class catalog with per-fund tabs, watchlist, CSV/TXT export. TailwindCSS, dark mode, Bun updater.

after.description: AAM ETF.
